title: Documents and ingestion
requirement: Find source-grounded Markdown/document content with controlled ingestion and retrieve the original body before relying on a result.
a_deciding_comparison_would_measure: Seal a representative document corpus and relevance judgments; repeat randomized lexical/hybrid retrieval plus difficult-layout ingestion before changing defaults.
target_hosts: Primary: a new WSL2 Ubuntu-family instance on a Windows workstation, x86_64, 48 cores, 104 GB RAM, NVIDIA RTX 4090 24 GB. Secondary: macOS arm64 laptops. Users: Claude Code and Codex agent sessions on that host.
